name: Tsagan, Raider Warlord — Max speed: Yes gives it deathtouch and other creatures you control first strike
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). "Max speed — Tsagan has deathtouch and other creatures you control have first strike." Only the first subject was read (one keyword grant per sentence), and "Max speed" was stripped as a flavour ability word, so deathtouch applied at any speed. The two subjects are now two sentences, and Max speed is a toggle on the permanent ("You have max speed"), since speed is not tracked. With it on, Tsagan has deathtouch and the Bears first strike; Tsagan itself does not get first strike.
